title: Coty plans to axe 155 of its 200 jobs in France, unions say
summary: The US beauty and fragrance group Coty, whose brands include Marc Jacobs, Calvin Klein, Rimmel and Bourjois, among others, plans to cut 155 of its 200 jobs in France, union representatives told AFP on Friday, 6 November. The company confirmed that it had proposed an overhaul of its operating model in the country.
